title: Global AI Incident Reporting Interoperability & Independent Research Pilot
objective: Map the OECD common reporting framework and AI Incidents Monitor, identify a useful non-duplicative role for an independent research institute, and design a 90-day pilot.
scope: OECD common reporting framework and its 29 criteria
OECD AI Incidents Monitor methodology and limitations
out_of_scope: Building a competing incident database before gap analysis
Contacting or representing OECD, governments, companies or victims
deliverables: 90-day pilot roadmap with owners, risks and measurable acceptance criteria
acceptance_tests: At least three authoritative primary sources
Distinguish OECD framework, OECD monitor and proposed institute activity
Recommendations labeled Assessment, not Verified facts
No claims of partnership, endorsement or institutional authority
